blocks.orig: Board a semi-submarine and experience an immersive underwater adventure around the beautiful Bawe Island, in the middle of the Indian Ocean on the west of Zanzibar’s capital Stone Town. A semi-submarine vessel stays afloat but has space below the waterline featuring underwater windows that allow you to explore the reef from the comfort of your seat!
blocks.html: Step aboard a semi-submarine for an immersive underwater trip around lovely Bawe Island, out in the Indian Ocean to the west of Stone Town, Zanzibar’s capital. The vessel floats on the surface, but below the waterline it has a space with underwater windows, so you can discover the reef while sitting comfortably in your seat!
